grid.storage_order_rgb: (k, j, i, channel) uint8, channel = R, G, B
grid.frame: VHF-image-2022 (Denver label-map frame; +i subject right, +j anterior, +k superior)

method.photograph_prefilter: 2 x 2 box average (Denver derived its aligned slices the same way; 1 Denver px = 2.0000 photograph px)
method.sampling: bilinear (scipy map_coordinates order 1) at Denver pixel centres mapped by the per-slice similarity of the transform; outside the photograph = 0
method.similarity: Denver (i, j) -> photograph (c, r) = s R(theta) (-i, j) + (tc, tr); the -i is the left-right mirror Denver applied
method.check: NCC of 0.218 R + 0.710 G + 0.089 B against Denver aligned gray slice k; mirror control every 25 slices

ignore_rule: slices with status other than usable / usable-flagged are zero in the RGB volume and are IGNORE for every consumer: never background, never training, never scoring; the labels NIfTI still holds Denver labels there, the status column decides

per_slice.reason: non-tissue fraction under the original labels 0.224 above the band threshold 0.223
non-tissue fraction under the original labels 0.253 above the band threshold 0.223
non-tissue fraction under the original labels 0.239 above the band threshold 0.224
non-tissue fraction under the original labels 0.328 above the band threshold 0.224
non-tissue fraction under the original labels 0.354 above the band threshold 0.224
non-tissue fraction under the original labels 0.231 above the band threshold 0.224

limits: image-to-image resampling of one publication onto the grid of another; no anatomical content is checked
usable-flagged slices rest on the whole-frame identity only; the flag is in the status column
excluded slices are not wrong: their photograph is one of the ambiguity set; they wait for a different criterion, never a lower threshold
observability was measured only in the block-boundary bands; an unflagged slice elsewhere was not inspected
